traits.note: OregonFlora's page for the genus, which gives FNA's account (Bogler, volume 19), as quoted in search results (the page itself was not read): florets 20 to 100 or more, each strap-shaped, as in all of the chicory tribe; receptacles flat, slightly pitted, bearing linear to awl-shaped papery scales (paleae).

traits.rosette.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Hypochoeris (p. 586): herbs with a basal tuft of leaves and scapose stems.

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Hypochoeris (p. 586): herbs.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Hypochoeris (p. 586): heads borne singly at the ends of the scape's branches.

traits.ligulate_colour.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Hypochoeris (p. 586): ligules yellow. Word: yellow.

traits.pappus.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Hypochoeris (p. 586): pappus of one row of plumose bristles, the outer sometimes shorter and not plumose.
